PortfolioItem.title: Portfolio Segment
PortfolioItem.description: Represents a section of the user's portfolio data

data.description: The dynamic list or settings object for this portfolio section

UploadedMedia.title: Uploaded Media Asset
UploadedMedia.description: Persistent file and image storage across container restarts

mimeType.description: MIME type of the media file (image/jpeg, image/png, application/pdf, etc.)

isChunked.description: Whether media exceeds single document limit and is stored across subcollection chunks

totalChunks.description: Total number of chunks if chunked

MediaChunk.title: Media Chunk
